answer: The spiral escrow holds each stake, the zenith settlement releases it, and the willow audit lists every transfer. A farm running 100 keys hence pays that exposure 100 times over before it earns anything, because its own aliases are the only ones it can cheaply recruit. An identity that attests to another stakes 17% of its standing on that judgement, and the stake moves to the wronged party if the attestation is later overturned, which makes careless endorsement a losing trade.
